page.overview:
Who is Ichi?

Ichi was very overconfident in his abilities. He would talk down to and mock his opponents during battle. Like his comrades, he would not hesitate in using the Chimera Technique to merge with others, even if it meant distorting his own body.

Ichi had light-coloured eyes and brown hair. He was a tall, gaunt man that greatly resembled San, with the exception that he only had a single violet-coloured rectangular mark on his forehead, his bangs on his left side, and that while Ichi wore his cloak on the right side of his shoulder and straps from the left shoulder going down, San wore them the opposite direction. He had a mark on his back that was the same as the one in Hiruko's left palm. It is unclear if he and San were related.

Ichi had considerable skill in taijutsu, being able to keep up with Team Guy. He also utilised double-headed snakes in combat, due to the Chimera Technique. Using said snakes, Ichi could use the Summoning Technique, augment his arms, form nets and fire powerful projectiles.

Ichi was noted to have larger-than-normal chakra reserves. He was also quite durable, being able to survive Neji and Rock Lee's combined Revolving Heaven and Front Lotus techniques head on.
